welcome.title: A tour of the analyses
welcome.text: An analysis is one reading of a gel image: its lanes, bands and results. A one-minute tour; Esc leaves it, the Tour compass at the top brings it back.

steps.title: Find an analysis
steps.text: Search a name or a gel file, then narrow by status, assay or creator, and choose the sort order.

steps.title: One analysis
steps.text: Its name, its gel and assay, how many lanes and bands were drawn and when it was created. Click the name to open its page.

steps.title: Where it stands
steps.text: Draft: nothing drawn yet. In progress: being annotated. Completed: finished. Approved: final, its values are locked. A Rejected analysis counts nowhere.
